client_context: Blue Wattle Pty Ltd — 28-employee trades services group, June month-end close, payroll/BAS/loan evidence required before manager handoff.
generated_from: deterministic browser state; synthetic sample only

blocker_count.definition: blocked means not packet-ready; waiting-review, rejected/problem, and missing all block close until resolved

items.name: Payroll variance support
items.risk: High materiality; payroll variance is 14% above prior month
items.consequence: Cannot include payroll variance support in manager packet yet.

items.name: BAS export
items.source_system: ATO portal export supplied by client
items.risk: Wrong period can overstate GST control evidence
items.blocker: Wrong period: May instead of June.

items.name: Director loan statement
items.consequence: Close remains blocked until client responds.

staff.job: Keep close moving without overstepping review authority.
staff.allowed: Intake evidence, see blockers, approve blocker-only chase after reviewing unresolved state.
staff.blocked: Cannot accept evidence or include waiting-review items in the packet.
staff.refusal: Staff accept attempts produce a refusal event and no state change.

reviewer.job: Make the evidence decision that changes packet readiness.
reviewer.allowed: Accept or reject PAY-001 with reason and audit event.
reviewer.blocked: Cannot silently send client chases or hide unresolved items.
reviewer.refusal: Duplicate or unsupported decision is logged instead of overwriting history.

manager.job: Read whether close can proceed and why.
manager.allowed: Review packet, unresolved blockers, risk/materiality, owner trail, ageing, prior-period comparison, sign-off fields.
manager.blocked: Cannot treat demo hash as compliance-grade audit assurance.
manager.refusal: Packet labels unresolved blockers and demo boundary.

metrics.baseline_capture: two prior close cycles: duplicate asks, reviewer rework minutes, manager handoff time, late-close count

manager_handoff_hours.target: same day after reviewer decisions complete

metrics.price_hypothesis: AUD $3k–$8k concierge pilot; stop if no measurable close-readiness improvement
